line: RULES CHANGED: rooms/{CODE}/jw/{matchId}/{uid} — JAYWALK's proof node (H1: NEW — go · c/{i} · e; H3: every chunk c/{i} is now { s, at } — its packed hops + the SERVER's timestamp (at === now), written ONCE, i 0-9999) + still waiting from FR7 FIXES B: rooms/{CODE}/prism/{m}, oc/{m}, ocm/{m} (the host may delete ONE match's node — A SEAT IS NOT A PLAY) — RE-PUBLISH database.rules.json in the Firebase console (Realtime Database → Rules → paste the whole file → Publish); until then the old rules run: the old matches' nodes stay until the room is deleted (the fallback), and every jw write is refused — a JAYWALK run on the owner's phone still PLAYS (unproven, on its own seed) but is never counted and has no HOP AGAIN podium until the re-publish
